requirements.title: Shared authentication on every management entry point
requirements.description: Cloud server startup configures the shared api-core authentication so REST, Connect, SSE, WebSocket and legacy routes reject anonymous callers before any target effect.

validation.notes: Anonymous refused before handlers on every route class with a sign-in next action; FromEnvironment never resolves to anonymous (shared mode without providers, unknown mode and non-loopback bind without allowed hosts all fail startup); bounded bodies, per-principal effect concurrency, no-store; audit lines never carry body or credential canaries. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-012].
Anonymous request to every non-public registered route through the real router returns 401 with zero SSH calls; public health discloses nothing target-specific; audit canary test.
CLI attaches the operator bearer token; typed 401 maps to exit 2 with the sign-in next action.
Live curl proof after restart: anonymous execute on the production deployment returns 401 and leaves the row unchanged; personal-local CLI list succeeds from loopback.

requirements.title: Route/effect/target authorization matrix
requirements.description: A table-driven matrix classifies each route by effect (read, workload mutation, secret, host, interactive) and binds access checks to deployment, target, environment and scope; wrong-target, revoked and insufficient-scope requests are denied without disclosure.

validation.notes: Table invariants; scope via scopecatalog.Resolve; wrong-target grant refused without disclosure (id existence hidden from restricted principals; body-addressed legacy routes closed); revoked between admission and effect refused with forbidden_revoked; policy-file revocation honoured without restart; service principals confined to declared rows. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-013].
docs/reference/authorization-matrix.md is generated from the table and fails when stale; GET /api/v1/authz/matrix exports every row with its scope.

Route census walks the live mux router: every registered route classified, public rows allowlisted, stale rows detected; wrong-target grant refused on every target-bound and body-target route; service principal confined; revoked principal refused at the gated effect.

requirements.title: Browser origin, CSRF and WebSocket upgrade enforcement
requirements.description: Cross-origin mutation and unauthorized terminal upgrades are refused; interactive session lifetime obeys grant policy.

validation.notes: Same-origin, allowed-origin and loopback origins admitted; cross-origin and Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site mutations refused with forbidden_origin; interactive route requires an Origin; foreign Host refused with forbidden_host; expired credential refused and session context bounded by expiry. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-014].
Cross-origin request to every state-changing route refused; terminal upgrade refused for no principal, foreign origin and missing origin before any SSH session.
WebSocket upgrader admits only boundary-approved origins and refuses an absent Origin.
